# ARRI Shop

> > Official ARRI e-commerce platform for professional cinematography equipment, camera accessories, and certified pre-owned gear for ALEXA cameras and professional lens systems.

ARRI Shop serves as the direct sales channel for ARRI's extensive catalog of cinema camera accessories, matte box components, lens accessories, and battery solutions. The platform specializes in both new and certified pre-owned (CPO) equipment for professional filmmakers using ALEXA Mini, ALEXA Mini LF, and other professional cinema systems.

## Key Topics

- ARRI cinematography equipment
- ALEXA Mini and ALEXA Mini LF cameras
- Matte box accessories (LMB 4x5, LMB-25, MB-29, MMB-1, MMB-2)
- B-Mount battery systems
- Anti-reflection frames and filter accessories
- Reflex prevention rings (150mm)
- 4x5.65 filter systems
- Certified pre-owned (CPO) equipment
- Lens accessories (VP1, VP2, VP3)
- Smart focus control systems
- Professional cinematography gear
- Camera mounting solutions
- Glass filter holders
- Reduction rings and adapters
